run_mpc_autograd_cnn_training: run the MPC autograd CNN training example with default 2 parties and 3 epochs
run_multiprocess_launcher: run the MultiProcessLauncher to start multiple party processes for secure MPC training
validate_world_size: validate that the world size argument is greater than 1 for multi-party computation
run_experiment_with_args: run the experiment function that configures logging and calls run_mpc_autograd_cnn with parsed args
configure_training_hyperparameters: configure training hyperparameters including learning rate, batch size, epochs, and num samples via CLI
